**Before downloading**

1. Request each dataset from its principal investigator via DABI.
2. Download all files into one folder, keeping the provider's folder structure.

```bash
biosignal-data import dabi/dabi <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
